story.iWant: to be able to register for an account using my email and a password

tasks.task: (AC: #1) Implement request body validation for email and password.
(AC: #1) Hash password using bcrypt before storing in the users table.
(AC: #1) Return 201 Created with user ID and email on success.
(AC: #1) Return 400 Bad Request or 409 Conflict on error.
(AC: #1) Testing: Write unit tests for the registration endpoint, covering success and error cases.
(AC: #2) Manage form state for email, password, and submission status.
(AC: #2) Create API service function to call the registration endpoint.
(AC: #2) On successful registration, redirect the user to the /login page.
(AC: #2) Testing: Write unit tests for the RegistrationForm component, mocking the API service.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given I am on the registration page,
When I enter my email and a valid password,
And I am redirected to the login page.

doc.snippet: **Objective:** Create a secure endpoint and a user-facing form to allow new users to register for an account. * **API Endpoint:** `POST /api/v1/users/register` * **Request Body:** `{"email": "...", "password": "..."}` * **Success Response (201 Created):** `{"id": "...", "email": "..."}`
* **Database Naming:** Tables and columns will be snake_case. Tables will be plural (e.g., users). * **API Naming:** JSON fields will be snake_case. API endpoints will be resource-oriented.

* **Error Handling:** The REST API will use a standard error format: `{ "error": { "message": "...", "code": "..." } }`. * **Success Responses:** All successful API responses will be wrapped in a `data` object: `{ "data": { ... } }`.

* **As a new user,** I want to be able to register for an account using my email and a password, so that I can access the application. * **Acceptance Criteria:** Given I am on the registration page... Then my account is created and I am logged in.

constraints.constraint: The implementation should follow the REST API patterns and database naming conventions outlined in the architecture document.
The backend endpoint will be part of the main FastAPI application.
Passwords must be hashed using bcrypt before storage.
API responses must strictly follow the standard success/error wrappers defined in Architecture.

tests.standards: Use the "Testing Pyramid" strategy: many Unit Tests (Pytest, Jest), some Integration Tests.

ideas.idea: Test registration with existing email (should fail 409)
Test registration with weak password (should fail 400)
Test successful registration checks DB for hashed password
